author: ABMN Staff
title: Wedbush Begins Coverage on Apple (AAPL)
text:
Research analysts at Wedbush assumed coverage on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research report issued to clients and investors on Thursday, The Fly reports. The brokerage set an “outperform” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
AAPL has been the topic of several other research reports. Loop Capital lifted their price target on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, July 6th. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and issued a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 11th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have given a buy rating to the company. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $222.50.
